ai_positioning.summary: InterDigital does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing. The company focuses on wireless technology licensing and patent portfolio management.

risks.title: Uncertain revenue expansion opportunities
risks.score_rationale: Plans to expand revenue into video and cloud-based service licensing are uncertain as this market is less developed than device-based licensing. Service providers may use alternative technologies and lack comparable agreement benchmarks.
risks.summary: The company seeks to expand licensing activities to video and cloud-based service providers but faces uncertainty due to market immaturity and potential customer holdout behavior.

risks.title: Patent licensing negotiation challenges
risks.score_rationale: Negotiations with service providers for license agreements may be protracted and difficult, potentially delaying revenue realization and impacting financial results.
risks.summary: Patent licensing negotiations with service providers can be lengthy and complex, creating uncertainty in revenue timing.

risks.title: Intellectual property litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces significant litigation exposure in defending its intellectual property rights and patent portfolio, with potential adverse judgments.
risks.summary: Substantial exposure to intellectual property litigation and patent defense proceedings that could impact operations and financial condition.

risks.title: Patent law regulatory changes
risks.score_rationale: Potential reforms to patent legislation could materially impact the company's ability to enforce and protect intellectual property rights effectively.
risks.summary: Changes in patent legislation could adversely affect the company's capacity to defend and enforce its intellectual property portfolio.

risks.title: US-China trade and geopolitical tensions
risks.score_rationale: Deteriorating US-China relations could negatively impact business operations through tariffs, trade restrictions, and political pressure on technology licensing.
risks.summary: Trade conflicts and geopolitical tensions between the US and China could materially affect business operations and licensing arrangements.

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Economic uncertainty in mobile device markets could reduce customer capacity to enter into new licensing agreements and impact licensing revenue.
risks.summary: Macroeconomic headwinds may reduce market demand for new licensing agreements and delay customer decision-making.

risks.title: Royalty determination uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: The determination of royalty rates in licensing agreements involves uncertainty and could impact the revenue generated from licensing arrangements.
risks.summary: Uncertainty in determining appropriate royalty rates for licensing agreements may impact revenue realization.

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
